newsitem.title: USA: Alliance Pharm files S-3 for MDV deal.
newsitem.headline: Alliance Pharm files S-3 for MDV deal.

text.p: Alliance Pharmaceutical Corp said it filed an S-3 registration statement for 3,934,782 shares that may be issued to shareholders of MDV Technologies Inc as payment for the MDV stock pursuant to a merger agreement announced October 7, 1996.

Under terms of the agreement, Alliance will make installment payments to the MDV shareholders totaling $15.5 million during the next 12 months, with additional payments upon the occurrence of certain clinical development, licensing, or commercialization events.
All payments may be made in cash or stock, at Alliance's discretion.
